lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity local maxima are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with the largest blobs forming a 2D grid relative to the pectoral fin attachment.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontally aligned spot clusters, creating high-luminance anchor nodes across the visible lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal side to a shaded gradient on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-density spatial distribution of small, circular, high-luminance spots across its entire dorsal surface, contrasting with the larger macro-blobs on the trunk.
